Gossip message serialization for pull requests, contact info, and CRDS votes.

# Purpose
This C file implements serialization helpers for Gossip protocol data. It contains code to encode a `fd_contact_info_t` value into the wire format used by Gossip, and it also builds a pull request message and a CRDS vote message. The file uses small helper macros such as `SER_INIT`, `INC`, and `CURSOR` to write fields into an output buffer while tracking the current offset and the number of bytes consumed.

A main part of the file is [`contact_info_convert_sockets`](<#contact_info_convert_sockets>), which converts the fixed socket array in `fd_contact_info_t` into two encoded lists: unique IP addresses and socket entries sorted by port. The encoder then writes the contact info fields, version data, address list, socket entry list, and extension length into the output buffer. The file also defines [`varint_encode`](<#varint_encode>) for variable-length integer encoding, and it uses it for fields such as version numbers and port offsets. The public functions [`fd_gossip_pull_request_init`](<#fd_gossip_pull_request_init>), [`fd_gossip_contact_info_encode`](<#fd_gossip_contact_info_encode>), and [`fd_gossip_crds_vote_encode`](<#fd_gossip_crds_vote_encode>) form the external interface for building Gossip messages in serialized form.
